summary: Chat now accepts image attachments with previews and sends them as image content to the selected model.
instructions: In chat, choose + Image beside the message box. Attach up to four PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF images, no larger than 5 MB each. Review the previews, remove any unwanted images, then send with an optional message. Connect a service in Settings first and finish any pending command approval before sending images. Attachments stay in memory while you edit and remain available if the chat rejects a send; accepted images are stored with the local chat transcript. Image requests use your selected service, never an automatic switch to API billing. OpenAI API and ChatGPT use image input blocks; Anthropic API uses base64 image blocks; Claude subscription passes image blocks through the official Claude Code client's streaming input. Model/account image support and provider limits still apply. Tested attachment validation, local persistence, model request translation, Claude conversation replay, command approval integration, desktop/mobile previews, image-only sends, failed-send preservation, successful clearing, and supervisor recovery. Live provider image inference was not tested.
